CustomObject.description: Catalog of raw material types and service categories a supplier may provide, and the compliance domains each one guarantees. Single source of truth for the "Raw material type" / "Service category" dropdowns on supplier intake (scProcurementConsole) — replaces the hardcoded JS/Python lists so a new material (for any industry) can be added by creating a record here, with no code deploy on either the Salesforce or engine side. Domains__c values must match the domain slugs used by the Python RAG corpus (quality, conflict, material, cyber, trade, finance, general).
CustomObject.label: Material Type
